INNER HEAD. [3] [Cact.]
Heavy pain like a weight on vertex ; > by pressure, but < from sounds, hearing talking, or strong light.
Right-sided headaches and neuralgias which are periodic, pulsating and throbbing, and of an extreme type.
Cerebral congestion.
Sanguineous apoplexy.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Cact.]
Suffocative constriction at throat, with full throbbing carotids. θ Angina pectoris.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Cact.]
Hematemesis.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Cact.]
Feeling as of a cord tightly tied around lower part of chest ; marking out attachment of diaphragm. θ Rheumatism of diaphragm.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Cact.]
Severe gastro-enteritis.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Cact.]
Fluent hemorrhoids.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Cact.]
Hæmaturia ; urination prevented by clots.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Cact.]
Constriction of vagina preventing coition. θ Vaginismus.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Cact.]
Difficulty of breathing ; continued oppression and uneasiness, as if chest was constricted with an iron band, and could not dilate for normal respiration.
Oppression of chest, as from a great weight, difficult breathing ; uneasiness, as if an iron band prevented normal motion of chest.
Periodical attacks of suffocation, with fainting, cold perspiration on face, and loss of pulse.
Could only breathe with shoulders elevated and lying on back. θ Cardiac rheumatism.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Cact.]
Congestion to chest, which prevents lying down ; palpitation ; constriction of chest.
Hæmoptysis, with marked arterial excitement (but less fever and restlessness than Acon.) ; convulsive cough.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Cact.]
Sensation of constriction in heart, as if an iron hand prevented its normal movements.
Constant pain in region of heart, with sensation as if heart was "bound down," or "had not room enough to beat," or "as if bolts were holding it." θ Sequel to rheumatism.
Feeling as if heart was compressed or squeezed by a hand.
Heart seemed to be held by an iron hand for many hours. θ Angina pectoris. θ Cardiac rheumatism. θ Fatty degeneration. θ Hypertrophy.
Palpitation of heart, continued day and night ; < when walking, and at night, when lying on left side.
Heart disease, with œdema of left hand only.
Aneurism of heart and large arteries.
Hypertrophy, with dilatation ; patient pulseless, extremely exhausted, panting and sad, cannot lie down or speak ; has scarcely slept for fifteen days ; forgetful ; feet œdematous.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Cact.]
Sleeplessness.
   

FEVER. [40] [Cact.]
At 1 P. M. slight chill, then burning heat, dyspnœa, pulsating pain in uterine region, ending in slight sweat.
Quotidian, 11 A. M. ; great coldness for two hours, then burning heat, with great dyspnœa, violent pain in head coma, stupefaction, insensibility till midnight, then unquenchable thirst and sweat.
Intermittent fever, with derangement of stomach.
Where perspiration fails to show itself. θ Intermittent.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Cact.]
   

TISSUES. [44] [Cact.]
Congestions.
Organic diseases of the heart.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Cact.]
Twitching of muscles and sensation of constriction produced by touching affected part.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Cact.]
Sanguineous congestions in persons of plethoric habit.
Woman, æt. 30, frequent attacks of angina pectoris.
